description: tr-1: the current public key roster of a private-claims team (role ids, X25519 + ML-KEM-1024 receive keys, Ed25519 + ML-DSA-87 signing keys), its roster_sha256 and version history. Every version is a chained ledger record, so a swapped key shows as a new version: pin roster_sha256 and compare before sealing to a roster.
name: get_team_roster
title: Read a team's chained key roster
